headline: Public hearing on a resolution for a home rule petition on maintenance of unaccepted ways.
summary: A resolution would authorize a home rule petition on maintaining unaccepted ways. Mayor Beauregard and the Unaccepted Ways Committee requested it.
items: TR-26-100: resolution authorizing a home rule petition relative to unaccepted ways maintenance in Methuen, requested by Mayor Beauregard and the Unaccepted Ways Committee
location: Great Hall, Searles Building, 41 Pleasant Street, Methuen, MA 01844
plain_text:
Methuen City Council 
Great Hall, Searles Building, 3rd. Floor
41 Pleasant Street, Methuen, MA 01844
City Council Public Hearing, Monday, November 16, 2026, 
6:45 PM
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
MONDAY, NOVEMBER 16, 2016 @ 6:45 P.M.
There will be a Public Hearing of the Methuen City Council on 
Monday, November 16, 2026, at 6:45 p.m. in the Great Hall, 
Searles Building, Methuen, MA
AGENDA
TR-26-100 – A Resolution Authorizing a Home Rule Petition 
Relative to Unaccepted Ways Maintenance in the City of 
Methuen (Requested by Mayor Beauregard and Unaccepted 
Ways Committee) 
Neily Soto
Chair of the City Council
For residents wishing to view the meeting, please:
l Tune in to Channel 8 (Comcast) or Channel 32 (Verizon) 
l Watch the live stream at Methuen.gov/livestream
This meeting will be archived and viewable on demand within one to three business days at 
https://methuentv.cablecast.tv/internetchannel?site=2
Anyone needing an access accommodation to participate in City of Methuen programs or 
services, please contact Felix Garcia, ADA Coordinator at 978 -802-8001 or 
fgarcia@methuen.gov at least two weeks in advance, or two business days before any 
board or commission meeting. · This notice is available in alternative formats upon 
request.
